name: Avoid routines
description: The adversary is avoiding routines because they could be analyzed over a longer period of time and could result in de-anonymization.

subtechniques.name: Avoid patterns
subtechniques.description: Patterns can be analyzed and could link certain activities back to you. To prevent this, patters and routines should be avoided. For example by avoiding posting at different times on a forum.

subtechniques.name: Avoid using the same place twice
subtechniques.description: To prevent routines and linking activities back to you when using public Wi-Fi, it should be avoided to use the same place twice.
